closures.observed_problem: The Front Office runtime used /front-office/* aliases, singular /walk-in and a receipts-only destination instead of the 19-page canonical map.
closures.evidence: Pre-change router inventory versus the generated navigation contract.
closures.root_cause: The role router predated the binding UI account contract.
closures.why_root_cause: Every mismatch originated in one legacy route tree; screens and APIs were already present for most destinations.
closures.correct_fix: Install 17 host-relative canonical routes, retain narrow compatibility redirects and leave two gates unrouted.
closures.proof: 17 canonical deep links pass; gated direct links fail closed.
closures.remaining_risk: Canonical no-volume host routing passed 51/51 production-image checks; only post-merge lifecycle verification remains.

closures.observed_problem: No truthful Dashboard could be composed without querying first pages from several paginated collections.
closures.evidence: Endpoint and page inventory showed no branch-today aggregate.
closures.root_cause: Shipped domain APIs own individual collections, not a Front Office presentation projection.
closures.why_root_cause: Client aggregation would produce incomplete counts and duplicate business-day rules.
closures.correct_fix: Add a read-only, branch-scoped server projection over shipped facts with Nairobi business-day boundaries.
closures.proof: Workspace count/state assertions and Dashboard browser request pass.
closures.remaining_risk: Query cost is bounded to one branch but remains observable in production.

closures.observed_problem: The legacy receipts path could not show recorded payments awaiting Finance without exposing the Finance checker view.
closures.evidence: Payment-group resource/permission inventory and maker/checker authority rule.
closures.root_cause: Available views were either receipt-only or Finance-owned full payment groups.
closures.why_root_cause: Front Office needs its submitted evidence outcome, not checker mutation fields or raw references.
closures.correct_fix: Add a paginated maker-safe status projection exposing decision state and automatic original-receipt readiness only.
closures.proof: Focused test rejects checker terms/controls and proves pending-validation semantics.
closures.remaining_risk: No manual issue control exists by design.

closures.observed_problem: Daily Activity had no Front Office-safe route and raw Audit-account payloads were overbroad.
closures.evidence: Canonical page required a day log; runtime exposed only append-only audit domain facts.
closures.root_cause: No presentation boundary mapped append-only events to safe operational labels.
closures.why_root_cause: Reusing Audit UI/API would cross role authority and expose internal payloads.
closures.correct_fix: Project current-day, same-branch actions to a narrow paginated timeline.
closures.proof: Branch isolation, masking and chronological UI assertions pass.
closures.remaining_risk: Unknown future event types intentionally fall back to a safe generic label.

closures.observed_problem: Queue transfer mutation existed but had no dedicated canonical accessible screen.
closures.evidence: Route/controller/policy inventory versus navigation contract.
closures.root_cause: The prior UI exposed queue management without a persistent transfer context.
closures.why_root_cause: Backend transfer policy/state machine already satisfied authority; only the presentation seam was absent.
closures.correct_fix: Add a subject-and-assignment page using existing eligibility and transfer endpoints.
closures.proof: Direct deep link, eligible list, reason and disabled confirmation states pass.
closures.remaining_risk: Mutation behavior remains owned by Phase 16B.

closures.observed_problem: No Front Office Account and Preferences route existed.
closures.evidence: Canonical map versus account router inventory.
closures.root_cause: The shared own-account runtime had not been composed for the role.
closures.why_root_cause: Building business or staff settings would exceed Front Office authority; the own-security runtime already existed.
closures.correct_fix: Wrap own Magic Link identity, MFA, sessions, theme and assigned branch context only.
closures.proof: Account resolves and forbidden business/staff controls are absent.
closures.remaining_risk: Notification preferences remain gated with Phase 21N.

closures.observed_problem: Operational Search rendered outside the role shell and could navigate to legacy Front Office URLs.
closures.evidence: Initial focused Playwright failures on page, responsive and axe cascaded from /search.
closures.root_cause: The cross-account utility route was registered as standalone and its Front Office result definitions retained legacy prefixes.
closures.why_root_cause: The same route was the only failed page across all widths and axe cases.
closures.correct_fix: Nest /search in RoleShell and update role-aware canonical deep links.
closures.proof: The exact 11 failed scenarios reran 11/11 green, then the full focused suite passed.
closures.remaining_risk: Other accounts retain the shared utility and are covered by router/component regression tests.

closures.observed_problem: Front Office navigation placed Utility second instead of last.
closures.evidence: Initial focused group-order assertion failed against the binding account map.
closures.root_cause: Generic group sorting did not encode the role's binding placement order.
closures.why_root_cause: All links existed; only group ordering was wrong.
closures.correct_fix: Add the explicit Front Office group order without changing other account navigation.
closures.proof: Eight group headings match the canonical order.
closures.remaining_risk: Generated navigation remains checked for drift.

closures.observed_problem: Several UI-13 layouts used sm:/xl: utilities that do not exist in the pinned Tailwind breakpoints.
closures.evidence: Token/config inspection showed only md=768 and lg=1025 while source searches found inactive aliases.
closures.root_cause: Inherited conventional Tailwind aliases conflicted with the product's three-band responsive contract.
closures.why_root_cause: Generated CSS could not activate those transformations at any width.
closures.correct_fix: Replace UI-13-owned sm/xl rules with md/lg contract boundaries.
closures.proof: All 17 pages have zero horizontal overflow at seven required widths.
closures.remaining_risk: Other phases own non-UI-13 inactive aliases outside touched surfaces.

closures.observed_problem: Inherited lists and forms remained visually flat and below the six supplied benchmarks after functional activation.
closures.evidence: First screenshot review of Clients, Walk-Ins, Queue and Invoices showed generic headings, cards and action hierarchy.
closures.root_cause: UI-13 initially reused domain components without a role-level visual composition layer.
closures.why_root_cause: Functionality and tests passed while the mandatory visual rubric did not.
closures.correct_fix: Introduce SvOperationalHero and refine task panels, semantic status, action hierarchy, workflow strips and light/dark surfaces.
closures.proof: All 17 pages score 27–30/30 with required criteria at 2 and hashed light/dark evidence.
closures.remaining_risk: Cross-account release-wide visual comparison remains UI-16.

closures.observed_problem: The first payment-status resource exposed checker-named validated_at/rejected_at fields.
closures.evidence: Focused API security test failed on the forbidden validation/checker vocabulary.
closures.root_cause: Timeline convenience fields mirrored Finance lifecycle terminology across the maker boundary.
closures.why_root_cause: The fields were unnecessary for Front Office to know decision state and receipt readiness.
closures.correct_fix: Remove checker timeline fields and retain only maker-safe decision state, recorded time and receipt availability.
closures.proof: PostgreSQL focused suite passes 3 tests/36 assertions and forbidden terms are absent.
closures.remaining_risk: Decision state remains read-only and server-owned.

closures.observed_problem: Visual screenshot settling and the all-page dark axe pass initially produced misleading scroll clips and a 30-second timeout.
closures.evidence: Human screenshot review plus failed dark harness run: 1 timed out, no axe violation emitted.
closures.root_cause: The harness captured before fonts/images/scroll fully settled and 17 sequential axe analyses exceeded the default timeout.
closures.why_root_cause: Product assertions remained green; rerunning with settled capture and test-specific capacity completed all pages.
closures.correct_fix: Await assets/fonts, normalize scroll on animation frames, and set a 120-second timeout only for the 17-page dark pass.
closures.proof: All 17 dark pages pass axe 0 serious/0 critical and produce stable hashed captures.
closures.remaining_risk: CI performance is covered by the explicit bounded timeout.

closures.observed_problem: The focused landing-content suite failed when the new Account card rendered.
closures.evidence: RoleLandingContent.spec reported no match for named route front-office.account.
closures.root_cause: The isolated test router fixture registered Dashboard/Get Started/Search but not the newly live canonical Account route.
closures.why_root_cause: The production router and focused browser route were already green; only RouterLink resolution inside the fixture failed.
closures.correct_fix: Register /account as front-office.account in the fixture.
closures.proof: Focused frontend suite reran 61/61 green.
closures.remaining_risk: The inventory bidirectional guard separately covers production routes.

closures.observed_problem: Full Vitest failed two bidirectional runtime-inventory assertions after canonical routing activation.
closures.evidence: screenInventory.spec rejected stale front-office.landing and missing front-office.clients-create, then enumerated the role tree drift.
closures.root_cause: The older runtime register was separate from the UI-07 canonical page contract and had not been reconciled to UI-13 route names/supporting destinations.
closures.why_root_cause: The canonical navigation generator was green while the independent runtime-register guard failed in both directions.
closures.correct_fix: Update the authoritative inventory JSON to the 21 actual Front Office production routes, regenerate all owned specs, and refresh the YAML file snapshot.
closures.proof: The 14-test bidirectional inventory contract passes and the production build resolves all lazy routes.
closures.remaining_risk: Generated current projections remain guarded in final deterministic checks.

closures.observed_problem: A full Vitest rerun timed out two of 79 public legal-page cases while their dynamic document chunks were cold under full-suite contention.
closures.evidence: Finance data-policy/privacy-policy failed the default 1-second wait; both exact cases passed 2/2 in 442ms in isolation.
closures.root_cause: The observable-outcome wait retained Vitest's 1-second default, below the cold-import latency seen with 145 files running concurrently.
closures.why_root_cause: No content assertion failed and the exact rerun was green without source changes.
closures.correct_fix: Give the existing outcome-based wait a bounded 5-second capacity without weakening its selector or assertions.
closures.proof: Final full Vitest passes 145 files and 1,402/1,402 tests.
closures.remaining_risk: A genuine load failure still times out and fails within five seconds.

closures.observed_problem: Traceability initially rejected provisional UI-13 statuses and one Phase 18A route claim.
closures.evidence: Phase23TraceabilityTest reported five non-vocabulary in_progress tokens, stale front-office.payments and then a hostname-shaped candidate in a frontend-route cell.
closures.root_cause: Phase lifecycle vocabulary and row-status vocabulary are intentionally different, while the old payment route and dotted host prose were parsed as current frontend route claims.
closures.why_root_cause: All failures were deterministic schema/route-reference diagnostics from the traceability guard.
closures.correct_fix: Keep the phase in_progress in PROGRESS/proof, use implemented for pre-local-completion requirement rows, name canonical invoice-payment routes, and keep host prose out of the route field.
closures.proof: Traceability passes 15 tests/20 assertions with UI-13 excluded from verified phases.
closures.remaining_risk: No remaining local lifecycle risk; merge verification is intentionally owned by the next-phase reconciliation model.

closures.observed_problem: The authoritative full PostgreSQL run finished runtime coverage but failed four deterministic documentation/current-consumer assertions.
closures.evidence: 2,984 passed / 14 skipped / 4 failed / 48,788 assertions; failures were confined to UI-01 retired-identity, UI-07 notification-gate and related route projections.
closures.root_cause: UI-13 canonical activation changed current routes and gate ownership while predecessor consumer registries retained the UI-12 projection.
closures.why_root_cause: All application/runtime tests passed; the four failures reproduced only in deterministic generated/consumer checks and named the stale identities directly.
closures.correct_fix: Register the five intentionally retired Front Office identities, retain the now-live dashboard identity, align Notifications to its inert gate, and regenerate only current projections.
closures.proof: The complete invalidated consumer set passes 54 tests / 6,746 assertions; runtime source was unchanged, so the phase invalidation rule does not require another full backend run.
closures.remaining_risk: None within UI-13; current projections remain deterministic CI gates.

closures.observed_problem: Whole-product browser consumers failed legacy Front Office deep links and exact text checks after canonical activation.
closures.evidence: Pre-authoritative broad runs identified missing supported /front-office/* shapes and statuses whose accessible text included contextual copy.
closures.root_cause: The new route tree retained only a subset of established bookmarks, while status assertions treated accessible names as visible-token equality.
closures.why_root_cause: The failures resolved when the exact legacy shapes were routed to canonical pages and semantic assertions accepted their contextual accessible labels.
closures.correct_fix: Add 19 narrow same-account compatibility redirects and use containment for accessible status labels without weakening state assertions.
closures.proof: All affected cases and final 1,526/1,526 whole-product run pass.
closures.remaining_risk: Compatibility paths are enumerated and cannot cross account hosts.

closures.observed_problem: Phase 22 Search browser coverage used an invalid Front Office role fixture after account-contract activation.
closures.evidence: The Search scenario was denied before exercising its intended scoped-result behavior.
closures.root_cause: The fixture used a legacy audit-role assumption and omitted the active front_office.search permission.
closures.why_root_cause: Production authorization was correct; the same scenario passed once bootstrapped as the canonical account with its existing permission.
closures.correct_fix: Use the canonical Front Office role/account bootstrap and existing search permission, without permission-matrix change.
closures.proof: Search coverage and final 1,526/1,526 run pass.
closures.remaining_risk: Zero permission delta is preserved.

closures.observed_problem: Release-audit coverage retained legacy Front Office route keys, an incomplete permission fixture and a flat-color-only backdrop assertion.
closures.evidence: Broad browser runs failed canonical navigation, permission and computed-gradient checks before the authoritative run.
closures.root_cause: The cross-phase audit harness had not consumed UI-13 canonical identities and did not recognize intentional CSS gradients as visible backdrops.
closures.why_root_cause: Runtime pages and component gates were correct; failures were confined to stale audit keys/fixtures and CSS interpretation.
closures.correct_fix: Map canonical keys, provide the existing role permission baseline, and accept a visible computed gradient while retaining contrast checks.
closures.proof: Release audit passed through all account surfaces in the final 1,526-test run.
closures.remaining_risk: The assertion still rejects absent or transparent backdrops.

closures.observed_problem: The role-entry suite assumed every authenticated account retained its public landing destination.
closures.evidence: Front Office /front-office compatibility now intentionally resolves to its operational Dashboard.
closures.root_cause: A single eight-account expectation did not model UI-13's authenticated operational-entry change.
closures.why_root_cause: The other seven accounts remained correct and only Front Office diverged under the newly binding canonical contract.
closures.correct_fix: Retain the seven landing assertions and assert Front Office compatibility convergence to /dashboard separately.
closures.proof: All role-entry cases pass in the final 1,526/1,526 run.
closures.remaining_risk: No other account behavior changed.

closures.observed_problem: Long Windows browser runs intermittently failed while opening predecessor PNG and JSON evidence paths.
closures.evidence: UNKNOWN open failures occurred first in UI-04 screenshots and later in UI-06 FAQ screenshots/responsive-matrix finalization; product assertions were not implicated.
closures.root_cause: Evidence producers wrote browser buffers directly to paths that can be transiently held by Windows during a multi-hour run.
closures.why_root_cause: The exact product scenarios passed, failures moved among evidence files, and bounded retry stress completed 27/27 before the full run passed.
closures.correct_fix: Capture screenshots in browser memory and centralize all evidence writes behind a five-attempt bounded retry limited to open-contention error codes.
closures.proof: Stress proof passes 27/27; authoritative whole-product Playwright passes 1,526/1,526 with no retry, flake or skip.
closures.remaining_risk: Non-contention errors still fail immediately; retry is bounded to 1.5 seconds total backoff.

closures.observed_problem: The first Nginx syntax command failed because the production upstream name could not resolve.
closures.evidence: Standalone docker run reported host not found in upstream app at default.conf:51.
closures.root_cause: The syntax container was started before the isolated proof network and its app network alias existed.
closures.why_root_cause: The config intentionally targets app:9000; the exact same immutable Nginx image passed syntax once attached to the production-like network with that upstream resolvable.
closures.correct_fix: Make no source change; create the isolated no-volume topology in dependency order and run nginx -t on its production network.
closures.proof: Nginx syntax is ok/test successful; host proof passes 51/51; both containers and the network were removed.
closures.remaining_risk: Orchestration must continue to provide the configured app network alias, as docker-compose.prod.yml already does.

closures.observed_problem: The first staging command was blocked by an existing Git index lock.
closures.evidence: git add reported .git/index.lock already exists; no path was staged.
closures.root_cause: A zero-byte lock created four hours earlier remained after its owning Git process had exited.
closures.why_root_cause: Process inspection found no git.exe or gh.exe owner, the lock timestamps predated the staging attempt, and read-only git status remained healthy.
closures.correct_fix: Validate the exact absolute lock path, zero-byte state and absence of Git owners, then remove only that stale lock before restaging.
closures.proof: The exact stale lock is absent; repository reads remain healthy and staging is retried from an unchanged worktree.
closures.remaining_risk: None observed; no index content was written by the failed command.
